title: Articulation envelopes around authored poses
plainLanguage: The goal is not to bend every drawing infinitely. A piece can be authored for one pose and still allow a small, tested amount of movement around that pose.
purpose: Support the user’s desired “mostly held pose with some articulation” character system.

rules.statement: Record articulation as a tested envelope around an authored configuration, not as an assumed universal joint limit.
Start with held_pose or micro_adjustment grades; promote to bounded_joint or bounded_chain only after visual tests.
Articulation limits are artwork/view-specific even when the anatomical joint is universal.
If a movement causes seam failure, silhouette collapse, or implausible perspective, the envelope ends there unless new artwork exists.

implementation.currentSupport: Doll rig has rotation controls; Corpus Pane does not yet store tested part articulation envelopes.
implementation.futureWork: Derive envelopes through real assembly tests rather than generic anatomical limits.
